questions.question: For which types of out-of-pocket expenses do the Part 97 rules state that VEs and VECs may be reimbursed?

choices.A: Preparing, processing, administering, and coordinating an examination for an amateur radio operator license
choices.B: Teaching an amateur operator license examination preparation course
choices.C: No expenses are authorized for reimbursement
choices.D: Providing amateur operator license examination preparation training materials

questions.answer: Preparing, processing, administering, and coordinating an examination for an amateur radio operator license

questions.question: Who is tasked by Part 97 with maintaining the pools of questions for all US amateur license examinations?

choices.A: The VEs
choices.B: The FCC
choices.C: The VECs
choices.D: The ARRL

questions.answer: The VECs

questions.question: What is a Volunteer Examiner Coordinator?

choices.A: A person who has volunteered to administer amateur operator license examinations
choices.B: An organization paid by the volunteer examiner team to publicize and schedule examinations
choices.C: An organization that has entered into an agreement with the FCC to coordinate, prepare, and administer amateur operator license examinations
choices.D: The person who has entered into an agreement with the FCC to be the VE session manager

questions.answer: An organization that has entered into an agreement with the FCC to coordinate, prepare, and administer amateur operator license examinations

questions.question: What is required to be accredited as a Volunteer Examiner?

choices.A: Each General, Advanced and Amateur Extra class operator is automatically accredited as a VE when the license is granted
choices.B: The amateur operator applying must pass a VE examination administered by the FCC Enforcement Bureau
choices.C: The prospective VE must obtain accreditation from the FCC
choices.D: A VEC must confirm that the VE applicant meets FCC requirements to serve as an examiner

questions.answer: A VEC must confirm that the VE applicant meets FCC requirements to serve as an examiner

questions.question: What must the VE team do with the application form if the examinee does not pass the exam?

choices.A: Maintain the application form with the VEC’s records
choices.B: Return the application document to the examinee
choices.C: Send the application form to the FCC and inform the FCC of the grade
choices.D: Destroy the application form

questions.answer: Return the application document to the examinee

questions.question: Who is responsible for the proper conduct and necessary supervision during an amateur operator license examination session?

choices.A: The VEC coordinating the session
choices.B: The designated monitoring VE
choices.C: Each administering VE
choices.D: Only the VE session manager

questions.answer: Each administering VE

questions.question: What should a VE do if a candidate fails to comply with the examiner’s instructions during an amateur operator license examination?

choices.A: Warn the candidate that continued failure to comply will result in termination of the examination
choices.B: Immediately terminate the candidate’s examination
choices.C: Allow the candidate to complete the examination, but invalidate the results
choices.D: Immediately terminate everyone’s examination and close the session

questions.answer: Immediately terminate the candidate’s examination

questions.question: To which of the following examinees may a VE not administer an examination?

choices.A: Employees of the VE
choices.B: Friends of the VE
choices.C: Relatives of the VE as listed in the FCC rules
choices.D: All these choices are correct

questions.answer: Relatives of the VE as listed in the FCC rules

questions.question: What may be the penalty for a VE who fraudulently administers or certifies an examination?

choices.A: Revocation of the VE’s amateur station license grant and the suspension of the VE’s amateur operator license grant
choices.B: A fine of up to $1,000 per occurrence
choices.C: A sentence of up to one year in prison
choices.D: All these choices are correct

questions.answer: Revocation of the VE’s amateur station license grant and the suspension of the VE’s amateur operator license grant

questions.question: What must the administering VEs do after the administration of a successful examination for an amateur operator license?

choices.A: They must collect and send the documents directly to the FCC
choices.B: They must collect and submit the documents to the coordinating VEC for grading
choices.C: They must submit the application document to the coordinating VEC according to the coordinating VEC instructions
choices.D: They must return the documents to the applicant for submission to the FCC according to the FCC instructions

questions.answer: They must submit the application document to the coordinating VEC according to the coordinating VEC instructions

questions.question: What must the VE team do if an examinee scores a passing grade on all examination elements needed for an upgrade or new license?

choices.A: Photocopy all examination documents and forward them to the FCC for processing
choices.B: Three VEs must certify that the examinee is qualified for the license grant and that they have complied with the administering VE requirements
choices.C: Issue the examinee the new or upgrade license
choices.D: All these choices are correct

questions.answer: Three VEs must certify that the examinee is qualified for the license grant and that they have complied with the administering VE requirements

questions.question: On what frequencies are spread spectrum transmissions permitted?

choices.A: Only on amateur frequencies above 50 MHz
choices.B: Only on amateur frequencies above 222 MHz
choices.C: Only on amateur frequencies above 420 MHz
choices.D: Only on amateur frequencies above 144 MHz

questions.answer: Only on amateur frequencies above 222 MHz

questions.question: What privileges are authorized in the US to persons holding an amateur service license granted by the government of Canada?

choices.A: None, they must obtain a US license
choices.B: Full privileges of the General class license on the 80-, 40-, 20-, 15-, and 10-meter bands
choices.C: The operating terms and conditions of the Canadian amateur service license, not to exceed US Amateur Extra class license privileges
choices.D: Full privileges, up to and including those of the Amateur Extra class license, on the 80-, 40-, 20-, 15-, and 10-meter bands

questions.answer: The operating terms and conditions of the Canadian amateur service license, not to exceed US Amateur Extra class license privileges

questions.question: Under what circumstances may a dealer sell an external RF power amplifier capable of operation below 144 MHz if it has not been granted FCC certification?

choices.A: Gain is less than 23 dB when driven by power of 10 watts or less
choices.B: The equipment dealer assembled it from a kit
choices.C: It was manufactured and certificated in a country which has a reciprocal certification agreement with the FCC
choices.D: The amplifier is constructed or modified by an amateur radio operator for use at an amateur station

questions.answer: The amplifier is constructed or modified by an amateur radio operator for use at an amateur station

questions.question: Which of the following geographic descriptions approximately describes "Line A"?

choices.A: A line roughly parallel to and south of the border between the US and Canada
choices.B: A line roughly parallel to and west of the US Atlantic coastline
choices.C: A line roughly parallel to and north of the border between the US and Mexico
choices.D: A line roughly parallel to and east of the US Pacific coastline

questions.answer: A line roughly parallel to and south of the border between the US and Canada

questions.question: Amateur stations may not transmit in which of the following frequency segments if they are located in the contiguous 48 states and north of Line A?

choices.A: 440 MHz - 450 MHz
choices.B: 53 MHz - 54 MHz
choices.C: 222 MHz - 223 MHz
choices.D: 420 MHz - 430 MHz

questions.answer: 420 MHz - 430 MHz

questions.question: Under what circumstances might the FCC issue a Special Temporary Authority (STA) to an amateur station?

choices.A: To provide for experimental amateur communications
choices.B: To allow use of a special event call sign
choices.C: To allow a VE group with less than three VEs to administer examinations in a remote, sparsely populated area
choices.D: To allow a licensee who has passed an upgrade exam to operate with upgraded privileges while waiting for posting on the FCC database

questions.answer: To provide for experimental amateur communications

questions.question: When may an amateur station send a message to a business?

choices.A: When the pecuniary interest of the amateur or his or her employer is less than $25
choices.B: When the pecuniary interest of the amateur or his or her employer is less than $50
choices.C: At no time
choices.D: When neither the amateur nor their employer has a pecuniary interest in the communications

questions.answer: When neither the amateur nor their employer has a pecuniary interest in the communications

questions.question: Which of the following types of amateur station communications are prohibited?

choices.A: Communications transmitted for hire or material compensation, except as otherwise provided in the rules
choices.B: Communications that have political content, except as allowed by the Fairness Doctrine
choices.C: Communications that have religious content
choices.D: Communications in a language other than English

questions.answer: Communications transmitted for hire or material compensation, except as otherwise provided in the rules

questions.question: Which of the following cannot be transmitted over an amateur radio mesh network?

choices.A: Third party traffic
choices.B: Email
choices.C: Messages encoded to obscure their meaning
choices.D: All these choices are correct

questions.answer: Messages encoded to obscure their meaning

questions.question: Who may be the control operator of an auxiliary station?

choices.A: Any licensed amateur operator
choices.B: Only Technician, General, Advanced, or Amateur Extra class operators
choices.C: Only General, Advanced, or Amateur Extra class operators
choices.D: Only Amateur Extra class operators

questions.answer: Only Technician, General, Advanced, or Amateur Extra class operators

questions.question: Which of the following best describes one of the standards that must be met by an external RF power amplifier if it is to qualify for a grant of FCC certification?

choices.A: It must produce full legal output when driven by not more than 5 watts of mean RF input power
choices.B: It must have received an Underwriters Laboratory certification for electrical safety as well as having met IEEE standard 14.101(B)
choices.C: It must exhibit a gain of less than 23 dB when driven by 10 watts or less
choices.D: It must satisfy the FCC’s spurious emission standards when operated at the lesser of 1500 watts or its full output power

questions.answer: It must satisfy the FCC’s spurious emission standards when operated at the lesser of 1500 watts or its full output power
